doc.title: Mike Davis interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 1, 2024

title: Peter Gabriel on Letterman
summary: Davis describes a one-off live show with Peter Gabriel, whom he found remarkably kind.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: I have to remember that to use at some point — “a pet shop burning down.” How about Paul Simon or Peter Gabriel?

I did a live show with Peter Gabriel, I think it was on David Letterman I believe when it was still The Letterman Show. And I was always a big Peter Gabriel fan. This guy was like the nicest guy I’ve ever met, and talking to everybody and just like — and we were just there for the, it was kind of a one-off situation. So he could easily have just not addressed us at all, you know he didn’t have to and it wouldn’t have affected how the band would sound, but just like the nicest guy you could imagine and a very humble guy considering he was such a mega star.
